categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies BIP 157 message processing in src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Bitcoin Core drops compact filter requests for newly announced blocks when filter indexing lags, causing BIP 157 clients to disconnect or ban the node. The PR description notes that dropping requests for known blocks violates BIP 157 and links issues (#29655, #27085, neutrino#338) documenting light clients banning nodes. Handling racing requests resolves an interoperability flaw that penalizes nodes serving compact filters.
